$comment: INTEGRIQ DRAFT (native-data-gathering-provider, ported from spectr/connectors): Source and Job ship isEnabled false, per the requirement that a connector blocked on an unbuilt capability ships disabled. GAP: iterating the members of a multi-file .zip archive (the monthly bulk holds ~83 Atom files). Follow-up: the '.zip multi-member archive iterate' capability listed in native-data-gathering-provider tasks.md (Wave 2) has landed (SynchronizationService reads every member of a .zip page through ZipArchiveMembers, narrowed by Source configuration.zipMembers, set here to *.atom). The remaining GAP is size: a monthly archive unpacks in memory (capped at 256 MiB), so enable only after one watched live run confirms the month fits. ORIGINAL SPECTR NOTE: Phase-2 wave-2 OpenConnector ingestion config for Spain PLACSP (Plataforma de Contratacion del Sector Publico). concurrentie-analyse/scripts/sync/sync_spain_placsp.py fetches a MONTHLY BULK ZIP (`licitacionesPerfilesContratanteCompleto3_{YYYYMM}.zip`) containing ~83 per-day `.atom`/`.xml` files, each an Atom feed wrapping UBL/CODICE `ContractFolderStatus` objects. Public, unauthenticated (keyless - docstring: 'No auth required, fully public open data'). SHIPPED AS A DOCUMENTED DRAFT, Source + Job DISABLED, blocked by a genuine engine gap NOT closed by openconnector#105: .zip multi-file archive extraction. oc#105 added single-file gzip (`.jsonl.gz`) decompression and explicitly REJECTS .tar/.tar.gz (isTarGzEndpoint short-circuits to zero objects with a warning); a .zip is a multi-member archive - the engine has no unzip step and no way to iterate the ~83 member .atom files, each of which is itself a separate XML document. Even the transport is wrong for the single-body fetch->parse model: one HTTP GET yields a binary zip, and fetchSinglePageData() only ever attempts gunzip (this file is not gzip), then json_decode, then simplexml over the whole (still-zipped) body - all of which fail, silently returning zero. This is the 'documented draft, do not force it' case per the batch brief. The mapping below is a SKELETON only (id/title/organisation/country), keyed on the UBL XPaths the script uses (atom:id, ProcurementProject/cbc:Name, LocatedContractingParty/.../PartyName/Name, ItemClassificationCode for CPV, TenderSubmissionDeadlinePeriod/EndDate, AwardedTenderedProject/... for awards) but deliberately not fully fleshed out, because after a future zip+per-member-XML engine mode lands, each member's xmlToArray shape (with #text-wrapped leaves and namespace-stripped keys, per estonia_rhr.json) will need to be pinned live before the full field set is trustworthy. Recommended interim path: an ETL loader in etl/ (download zip, iterate members, parse UBL, bulk-create) - out of this batch's scope. TED v3 carries Spain's above-threshold EU notices meanwhile. The script's own CPV 48/72 client-side filter is a DB-side layer, not an API constraint.
